## Download

- **Windows:** [Writer-Setup.exe](https://github.com/StickmanNinja/SethWriter/releases/latest/download/Writer-Setup.exe). Windows 7 SP1, 8, 8.1, 10 and 11.
- **Mac:** [Writer.dmg](https://github.com/StickmanNinja/SethWriter/releases/latest/download/Writer.dmg). macOS 13 Ventura or later, Apple Silicon or Intel.

**Windows:** open `Writer-Setup.exe`. If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**. Writer installs for your account (no admin rights), adds Start menu and Desktop shortcuts, and appears in Apps & features so you can uninstall it there.

**Mac:** open `Writer.dmg` and drag **Writer** onto **Applications**. The first time you open it, macOS may say it can't check the app for malicious software. Choose **Done**, then open **System Settings › Privacy & Security**, scroll down and choose **Open Anyway**.

## What's new

- **Save as a Word document.** File › Save a copy › Word document (.docx) keeps your formatting, headings, lists, tables, pictures, links and page layout. It opens in Microsoft Word, Pages, Google Docs and LibreOffice.
- **Print.** Press Ctrl+P (⌘P on a Mac), click the printer button at the top, or choose File › Print. Only your document prints, at the page size and margins from the Layout tab, and highlights keep their colors. Choose Save as PDF in the print dialog to make a PDF.
